headline: HuyenBao v11.10 — legal disclaimer (EN/VI/ZH)
summary: A clear legal warning is now built into the game at every important surface: (1) the character-creation intro shows the disclaimer from the first screen and requires an explicit checkbox acknowledgment — 'Begin my life' stays disabled until the player confirms they understand this is a simulation game, not real life; (2) a persistent one-line disclaimer is shown in the footer on every tab during play and on the game-over screen; (3) every event modal (including AI prophecies) carries a note that AI-written content is fictional and never real-life advice. All text is localised in English, Vietnamese and 中文.
features: Intro disclaimer: warning box on the first screen of character creation + mandatory acknowledgment checkbox in the review step — 'Begin my life' is disabled until acknowledged

Persistent disclaimer line in the app footer (all tabs) and on the game-over screen: simulation game for entertainment only, do not apply to real life, player bears full legal responsibility for real-world actions
Event modal note: AI prophecies & life events are fictional — entertainment only, never real-life advice
Disclaimer text localised in EN / VI / 中文 (disc.title, disc.ack, disc.short, disc.aiNote)
Version bumped to v11.10 on homepage header + version.json
